title: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Amendment Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2011
ACT III OF 2011
OIL AND GAS REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the Oil and Gas
Regulatory
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
15th February, 2011]
No.F.9(32)/2010-Legis.,
dated 15-2-2011.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the
assent of the
President on 10th February, 2011, is hereby published for general
information:
Whereas,
it is expedient further to amend the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority
Ordinance, 2002 (XVII of 2002), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 3, Ordinance, XVII of 2002

ACT III OF 2011
ACT III OF 2011
OIL AND GAS REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the Oil and Gas
Regulatory
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
15th February, 2011]
No.F.9(32)/2010-Legis.,
dated 15-2-2011.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the
assent of the
President on 10th February, 2011, is hereby published for general
information:
Whereas,
it is expedient further to amend the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority
Ordinance, 2002 (XVII of 2002), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment
of section 3, Ordinance, XVII of 2002.---In the Oil and Gas Regulatory
Authority Ordinance, 2002 (XVII of 2002), in section 3, for
subsection (4)
the following shall
be substituted, namely:--
"(4)
The Chairman shall be an eminent professional of known integrity and competence
with a minimum of twenty years of related experience in law, business,
engineering, finance, accounting, economics, petroleum, technology, public
administration or management.".
